aboutMe.intro: Hi! I'm a developer who enjoys building things end to end, from the interface people click on to the servers and networks that keep it running.
aboutMe.body: I work across frontend, backend and infrastructure: building web apps with Angular and React, writing APIs with Flask and Node.js, designing databases, and deploying to the cloud with Docker, AWS and Azure. I like solving problems, learning new tools and turning ideas into working software.

highlights: Built and maintained web applications with Angular and Node.js used by internal and external teams.
Designed REST APIs and MySQL schemas, improving query performance on high-traffic endpoints.
Containerized services with Docker and automated deployments to AWS.
Developed Flask services and background jobs backed by MariaDB.
Managed Linux servers, Git workflows and code reviews on GitHub.
Put services behind Cloudflare for caching, DNS and protection.
Configured and troubleshot office networks, users and devices.
Automated repetitive reports and tasks with Visual Basic scripts.
Helped migrate internal tools and storage to Microsoft Azure.
